answer: Resist sybil swarms by making identity weight grow only from diverse, paid work. A new agent must mint a ferrous identity plate tied to one funding root; a second plate from the same root voids both names. The plate stays brittle until the agent finishes a tundra of spaced-out jobs with no sibling registrations and no shared clocks. Each job pays into a public lagoon of single-use receipts, and standing unlocks only when at least three unlinked counterparties have settled there. Cloning a handle stays cheap; cashing out requires real work, real waits, and unique capital once per mask.
